description: Airports of Vietnam is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Vietnam. A geospatial point dataset containing all known airports in Vietnam. It contains geospatial coordinates, object code, name, city, type, ICAO and IATA code. Coverage: Viet Nam. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Vietnam. Its tags are Airports and air travel, Infrastructure, Transport and shipping, Transport infrastructure and facilities. It offers 11 resource(s) in db_table, geojson, kml, shp, wms. The portal shows 2019-10-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
